head: 8 new entertainment apps for iPhone climbing the App Store this week
dek: Eight entertainment apps released in the last 60 days rose into the US App Store's Entertainment charts this week, including Jitless for PC games and Roku's new official app.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store Entertainment charts this week
means: If you're after something to play with, watch or give, these are small new apps people are buying now; two of them are made for the folding iPhone Duo.
todo: Check the App Store page for the price, in-app purchases and the iPhone it needs: Wowie works with the iPhone Duo.

list.name: Face Witness
list.what: Builds a face from separate eyes, nose, mouth and hair that you move and resize on a canvas.

list.name: Jitless
list.what: Plays PC and classic iOS games you own on iPhone and iPad, with touch, controller or keyboard and mouse.

list.name: Koimono: ASCII Koi Fish Pond
list.what: A calm koi pond drawn entirely in text characters that reacts when you touch the water.

list.name: reVRide Bike Sounds
list.what: Makes a kid's bike sound like a motorcycle, a horse, a dragon or a train, following the bike's speed.

list.name: Roku App (Official)
list.what: Streams free movies, shows and more than 500 live channels with no account or subscription needed.

list.name: Eyes Down: Bingo Caller
list.what: Turns an iPhone or iPad into a bingo caller and shows the board on a TV or projector.

list.name: Bobara: Calm Moments & Boba
list.what: A calm companion app with a capybara whose hot spring follows your local weather.

list.name: Wowie: Surprise Gift Box
list.what: Turns an iPhone Duo into a gift box with a message that opens when the other person unfolds the phone.
